name: Dropbox
description: Typed Dropbox API v2 files, folders, search, revision-aware transfers, sharing, accounts and quotas.

permissions.description: Fixed HTTPS Dropbox API/content API with externally issued OAuth bearer token. Explicit confirmed writes may upload, overwrite, share, move, delete and restore files. No filesystem, retries, refresh or listeners.

definitions.name: Dropbox Search Files
definitions.description: Dropbox Search Files
definitions.documentation: Dropbox Search Files: POST /2/files/search_v2. One bounded request, explicit cursors, no retries/redirects or URL following. OAuth token issuance/refresh external; DROPBOX_ACCESS_TOKEN or tokenSecret, or builtin $connection RuntimeConnection.config and credentials.accessToken. Only selectUser team impersonation is supported, requires team_data.member and provider entitlement. Optional typed pathRoot applies to file/sharing calls, never users calls. No custom endpoints/admin impersonation. Total wall-clock deadline starts before profile/secrets, default 10s max30s, dispatch/final guards plus abort, bounded cleanup100ms. Strict UTF-16/UTF-8, 512KiB request, 1MiB JSON response, 256KiB content chunks,64KiB argument/metadata headers. Known fields projected; uint64 byte counts/offsets decimal strings preserve precision, upload offsets emitted as JSON integer tokens. Session operations are explicit; caller retains session ID and advances offset from confirmed byte counts; close=false before finish. Upload update mode requires rev; no automatic conflict handling. File/folder/deleted and account/quota unions retained; unmodeled response fields omitted. Links are returned only, never fetched. No longpoll/watchers, refresh, full-team management or external credentials. Only selectUser team impersonation is supported, requires team_data.member and provider entitlement. Optional typed pathRoot applies to file/sharing calls, never users calls. Strict UTF-16/UTF-8, 512KiB request, 1MiB JSON response, 256KiB content chunks,64KiB argument/metadata headers. Known fields projected; uint64 byte counts/offsets decimal strings preserve precision, upload offsets emitted as JSON integer tokens. Session operations are explicit; caller retains session ID and advances offset from confirmed byte counts; close=false before finish. Upload update mode requires rev; no automatic conflict handling. File/folder/deleted and account/quota unions retained; unmodeled response fields omitted. Links are returned only, never fetched. No longpoll/watchers, refresh, full-team management or external credentials. definitions.name: Dropbox Append Upload Session
definitions.description: Dropbox Append Upload Session
definitions.documentation: Dropbox Append Upload Session: POST /2/files/upload_session/append_v2. One bounded request, explicit cursors, no retries/redirects or URL following. Requires confirmWrites=true and confirmation="DROPBOX files/upload_session/append_v2"; reconcile uncertain outcomes before repeating. OAuth token issuance/refresh external; DROPBOX_ACCESS_TOKEN or tokenSecret, or builtin $connection RuntimeConnection.config and credentials.accessToken. Only selectUser team impersonation is supported, requires team_data.member and provider entitlement. Optional typed pathRoot applies to file/sharing calls, never users calls. No custom endpoints/admin impersonation. Total wall-clock deadline starts before profile/secrets, default 10s max30s, dispatch/final guards plus abort, bounded cleanup100ms. Strict UTF-16/UTF-8, 512KiB request, 1MiB JSON response, 256KiB content chunks,64KiB argument/metadata headers. Known fields projected; uint64 byte counts/offsets decimal strings preserve precision, upload offsets emitted as JSON integer tokens. Session operations are explicit; caller retains session ID and advances offset from confirmed byte counts; close=false before finish. Upload update mode requires rev; no automatic conflict handling. File/folder/deleted and account/quota unions retained; unmodeled response fields omitted. Links are returned only, never fetched. No longpoll/watchers, refresh, full-team management or external credentials. definitions.name: Dropbox Copy File or Folder
definitions.description: Dropbox Copy File or Folder
definitions.documentation: Dropbox Copy File or Folder: POST /2/files/copy_v2. One bounded request, explicit cursors, no retries/redirects or URL following. Requires confirmWrites=true and confirmation="DROPBOX files/copy_v2"; reconcile uncertain outcomes before repeating. OAuth token issuance/refresh external; DROPBOX_ACCESS_TOKEN or tokenSecret, or builtin $connection RuntimeConnection.config and credentials.accessToken. Only selectUser team impersonation is supported, requires team_data.member and provider entitlement. Optional typed pathRoot applies to file/sharing calls, never users calls. No custom endpoints/admin impersonation. Total wall-clock deadline starts before profile/secrets, default 10s max30s, dispatch/final guards plus abort, bounded cleanup100ms. Strict UTF-16/UTF-8, 512KiB request, 1MiB JSON response, 256KiB content chunks,64KiB argument/metadata headers. Known fields projected; uint64 byte counts/offsets decimal strings preserve precision, upload offsets emitted as JSON integer tokens. Session operations are explicit; caller retains session ID and advances offset from confirmed byte counts; close=false before finish. Upload update mode requires rev; no automatic conflict handling. File/folder/deleted and account/quota unions retained; unmodeled response fields omitted. Links are returned only, never fetched. No longpoll/watchers, refresh, full-team management or external credentials. definitions.name: Dropbox Save Copy Reference
definitions.description: Dropbox Save Copy Reference
definitions.documentation: Dropbox Save Copy Reference: POST /2/files/copy_reference/save. One bounded request, explicit cursors, no retries/redirects or URL following. Requires confirmWrites=true and confirmation="DROPBOX files/copy_reference/save"; reconcile uncertain outcomes before repeating. OAuth token issuance/refresh external; DROPBOX_ACCESS_TOKEN or tokenSecret, or builtin $connection RuntimeConnection.config and credentials.accessToken. Only selectUser team impersonation is supported, requires team_data.member and provider entitlement. Optional typed pathRoot applies to file/sharing calls, never users calls. No custom endpoints/admin impersonation. Total wall-clock deadline starts before profile/secrets, default 10s max30s, dispatch/final guards plus abort, bounded cleanup100ms. Strict UTF-16/UTF-8, 512KiB request, 1MiB JSON response, 256KiB content chunks,64KiB argument/metadata headers. Known fields projected; uint64 byte counts/offsets decimal strings preserve precision, upload offsets emitted as JSON integer tokens. Session operations are explicit; caller retains session ID and advances offset from confirmed byte counts; close=false before finish. Upload update mode requires rev; no automatic conflict handling. File/folder/deleted and account/quota unions retained; unmodeled response fields omitted. Links are returned only, never fetched. No longpoll/watchers, refresh, full-team management or external credentials. Requires confirmWrites=true and confirmation="DROPBOX sharing/create_shared_link_with_settings"; reconcile uncertain outcomes before repeating. OAuth token issuance/refresh external; DROPBOX_ACCESS_TOKEN or tokenSecret, or builtin $connection RuntimeConnection.config and credentials.accessToken. Only selectUser team impersonation is supported, requires team_data.member and provider entitlement. Optional typed pathRoot applies to file/sharing calls, never users calls. No custom endpoints/admin impersonation. Total wall-clock deadline starts before profile/secrets, default 10s max30s, dispatch/final guards plus abort, bounded cleanup100ms. Strict UTF-16/UTF-8, 512KiB request, 1MiB JSON response, 256KiB content chunks,64KiB argument/metadata headers. Known fields projected; uint64 byte counts/offsets decimal strings preserve precision, upload offsets emitted as JSON integer tokens. Session operations are explicit; caller retains session ID and advances offset from confirmed byte counts; close=false before finish. Upload update mode requires rev; no automatic conflict handling. File/folder/deleted and account/quota unions retained; unmodeled response fields omitted. Links are returned only, never fetched. No longpoll/watchers, refresh, full-team management or external credentials. definitions.description: Dropbox Modify Shared Link
definitions.documentation: Dropbox Modify Shared Link: POST /2/sharing/modify_shared_link_settings. One bounded request, explicit cursors, no retries/redirects or URL following. Requires confirmWrites=true and confirmation="DROPBOX sharing/modify_shared_link_settings"; reconcile uncertain outcomes before repeating. OAuth token issuance/refresh external; DROPBOX_ACCESS_TOKEN or tokenSecret, or builtin $connection RuntimeConnection.config and credentials.accessToken. Only selectUser team impersonation is supported, requires team_data.member and provider entitlement. Optional typed pathRoot applies to file/sharing calls, never users calls. No custom endpoints/admin impersonation. Total wall-clock deadline starts before profile/secrets, default 10s max30s, dispatch/final guards plus abort, bounded cleanup100ms. Strict UTF-16/UTF-8, 512KiB request, 1MiB JSON response, 256KiB content chunks,64KiB argument/metadata headers. Known fields projected; uint64 byte counts/offsets decimal strings preserve precision, upload offsets emitted as JSON integer tokens. Session operations are explicit; caller retains session ID and advances offset from confirmed byte counts; close=false before finish. Upload update mode requires rev; no automatic conflict handling. File/folder/deleted and account/quota unions retained; unmodeled response fields omitted. Links are returned only, never fetched. No longpoll/watchers, refresh, full-team management or external credentials.
